name: Boku ga Kanojo no Pet ni Natta Riyuu
original_name: 僕が彼女のペットになった理由
source:
A masochist-oriented visual novel from Milk Soft!

When freshman Mitsuru Terashima is involved in a minor traffic accident, he learns more in the care of nurse Sayuri and her perky assistant Serina thank he could ever expect to get out of Tokyo University.

Are they just a couple of flirty hospital staff, or do they have some greater goal?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE151271.html]DLsite English[/url]]
